intent: Retry transient Jev classifier transport failures at most twice with cancellable 500 ms and 1 s backoff, preserve configured concurrency, and cancel compaction after terminal errors or exhausted retries.

findings.summary: Two instances: the gate lacks Pi's non-retryable provider-limit exclusion (a 403 `Your account was terminated due to billing` gets 3 attempts while `isRetryableAssistantError` returns false), and it omits transport text Pi classifies as retryable (`Connection error.`, `getaddrinfo ENOTFOUND`, `reset before headers`, `socket connection was closed`), which still cancel after one attempt.
findings.resolution: Exclude permanent quota and billing bodies before matching transport failures on returned and thrown paths; cover SDK transport text without adding HTTP-only retries. Regression tests: 9 fail against 281c90a, all 33 pass after the fix on Node 22 and 24; npm run check passes with 2687 tests.
